name: weekday_successor
description: Name the weekday immediately following a supplied day, with matched control retrieving a marker number.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
days='Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday'.split()
items=[];controls=[]
for i in range(84):
 d=i%7;tag=random.randint(10,99)
 stem=f'Record {tag}. Today is {days[d]}. '
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'Tomorrow is','answer':' '+days[(d+1)%7]})
 controls.append({'prompt':stem+'The record number is','answer':' '+str(tag)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':controls},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
